text:
maria: Hey team — planning to flip the new "inspect-mode" for the canary cohort after the midnight deploy. It will surface sampled request/response pairs in the console for up to 7 days for debugging. Questions: 1) does current PII redaction cover nested JSON fields? 2) what's the quota impact? 3) can we gate via devorg only?

kevin: +1 on canary, but worried about nested PII. Our deid heuristic only handles top-level keys and email patterns. We should add fast-hash redact for user_id before enabling.

sara: Re: quota — inspect-mode streams extra payloads to S3 for replay, about 0.6x the request size per sample. For 10% sampling on canary that'll add ~1TB/week. We can use smaller sample rate or size cap.

anil: We also need a clear breakglass audit trail. ops-bot will log who enables, when, and for which org. No manual toggle without 2FA.

ops-bot: [bot] inspect-mode toggle request logged: maria requested enable for canary at 2179998888. Audit ID: audit_202703. Requires 2 approvals.

lina: UX ask: in console, show a privacy badge on any exposed record with redaction level and why it passed. Helps reviewers avoid peeking at raw text.

maria: Good call. Also, can we do a pre-scan that automatically masks these fields: email, ssn, phone, and any string > 1000 chars? If masked, allow full inspect for the rest.

kevin: Quick prototype in the routing layer:

```
inspect_config:
  sample_rate: 0.02
  max_bytes: 5000
  redaction: [fast_hash, redact_emails]
  allow_orgs: ["devorg", "platform-teams"]
```

If we apply fast_hash on user_id and redact_emails, risk reduces a lot.

sara: Also recommend an emergency-off global circuit in case a bad rollout starts leaking PII. Have it trigger auto-rollout rollback and revoke console inspect tokens.

maria: Agree. Let's add an opt-in per-route flag and a console-only checkbox that requires both approvers.

devex-bot: [bot] Note: docs PR needed for inspect-mode + guidance: /docs/ops/inspect-mode.md

anil: Action items: 1) kevin to add nested-json deid rule (ETA 48h). 2) sara to update storage quota calc and propose sample rate. 3) lina to mock privacy badge UX. 4) ops to wire audit 2FA. 5) maria to open canary enablement RFC.

maria: I'll open the RFC now and tag each owner. Thanks.
